```{r}
#| include: false
# The tables come from scripts/08_data_tables.R, which also writes the download files.
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)

d <- readRDS("data/tables.rds")

gold       <- "#AF8B2F"
card_grey  <- "#36363A"
deep_grey  <- "#1F1F21"
line_grey  <- "#45454A"
text_light <- "#E8E6E1"

table_theme <- reactableTheme(
  color = text_light, backgroundColor = card_grey,
  borderColor = line_grey, highlightColor = line_grey,
  style = list(fontFamily = "DM Sans, sans-serif", fontSize = "0.85rem"),
  headerStyle = list(background = deep_grey, color = gold, textTransform = "uppercase",
                     letterSpacing = "0.08em", fontSize = "0.68rem", fontWeight = 500),
  searchInputStyle = list(backgroundColor = deep_grey, color = text_light, borderColor = line_grey),
  paginationStyle = list(color = text_light),
  pageButtonStyle = list(color = text_light)
)

# One section of the page: intro, download buttons, table, source line
show <- function(key) {
  t   <- d$tabs[[key]]
  tab <- t$screen
  cols <- list(Country = colDef(minWidth = 150, sticky = "left"),
               ISO3    = colDef(minWidth = 60))
  for (nm in names(tab)[-(1:2)]) {
    cols[[nm]] <- if (grepl(" - year$", nm)) colDef(name = "Year", minWidth = 60, format = colFormat(digits = 0))
                  else if (grepl("\\(people\\)", nm)) colDef(minWidth = 130, format = colFormat(digits = 0, separators = TRUE))
                  else colDef(minWidth = 120, format = colFormat(digits = 1))
  }
  tagList(
    p(class = "tab-intro", t$intro),
    div(class = "dl-buttons",
        a(class = "dl-btn", href = paste0("data/", key, ".csv"),  download = NA, "Download CSV"),
        a(class = "dl-btn", href = paste0("data/", key, ".xlsx"), download = NA, "Download Excel"),
        span(class = "dl-count", paste(t$n, "countries"))),
    if (isTRUE(t$acaps))
      p(class = "acaps-note", HTML(paste0(
        "The crisis severity column (ACAPS INFORM Severity Index) is shown here for reference only and is not included in the downloads. ",
        "The scores are free from <a href='https://www.acaps.org/en/data' target='_blank'>ACAPS</a>."))),
    reactable(tab, searchable = TRUE, compact = TRUE, highlight = TRUE, striped = FALSE,
              defaultPageSize = 10, showPageSizeOptions = TRUE, pageSizeOptions = c(10, 25, 100),
              defaultColDef = colDef(na = "–", headerVAlign = "bottom"),
              columns = cols, theme = table_theme),
    p(class = "source-line", t$source)
  )
}
```

<a class="back-link" href="https://dashboard.sa-analytical.com">&larr; Back to the dashboard</a>

These are the tables behind the dashboard maps, one per tab. Each table can be searched and sorted here, or downloaded as a **CSV** or **Excel** file. Every file names its sources and licences; the Excel files also have a Notes sheet explaining each column. Please credit the original data providers when you use the data.

Updated `r format(d$created, "%d %B %Y")`. The Funding (beta) tab is not included.

## Terms of use {#terms}

The data belong to their providers and are shared under their licences: IPC (public domain); World Bank World Development Indicators, INFORM Risk (European Commission Joint Research Centre) and humanitarian needs overviews via HDX (Creative Commons Attribution); ND-GAIN (University of Notre Dame, free and open access with citation). The providers are independent of SA Analytical and do not endorse these tables. Shares of the population in need are calculated by SA Analytical. Any errors are SA Analytical's own.
